title: Where should crops saved for replanting live?
question: One planted crop will return three crops. The player can carry ten before getting a silo, but you want to save up to ten of each species before selling any surplus. If those saved crops occupy her pouch, a full pouch can stop her harvesting the surplus she is meant to sell. Where should the saved stock live?
why_now: The seed-and-crop change is held until the shipping bin's keep-back rule works alongside the carrying limit.

options.label: Keep ten per species at the bin, separate from what she carries (Recommended)
options.detail: Deliveries first fill a persistent, plantable reserve of up to ten for each species; later deliveries of that species are sold. The player's carrying limit stays separate. Ten is a prototype number to tune during loop playtests.

options.label: Keep ten per species in her pouch
options.detail: The carrying limit and surplus-sale flow would also need redesign so a full reserve does not block harvesting crops to sell.

subject: What a harvest is worth
